doc: LAR6: deferred.textures (2) and deferred.offmain_adopted (1) add the loader-thread reference (res.gd frame 16: a worker Thread draws a pre-arm texture nothing else draws and clears it again), adopted from the off-main queue at the frame boundary. LAR5: the top-level emitters / process_materials / unknown_material_keyed are the pre-LAR5 late-arm expectations, kept for reference; the judged counts are per arm: `deferred` (extension loaded at birth, armed at frame 12, the emitter and its process materials adopted from the registry, unknown_material_keyed exactly 0) and `late` (the pre-arm emitter is refused preload-particles, never adopted, so emitters 0 and its unregistered process material is keyed through the LATE-RES re-link, unknown_material_keyed >= 1). Hand-derived from res.gd, not measured (README.md). Three 64x64 cells drawn only after the arm at fixture frame 12: TEX (a post-arm Sprite2D drawing a pre-arm ImageTexture), PPM (a pre-arm GPUParticles2D + ParticleProcessMaterial, detached until frame 15), ITEM (a pre-arm Node2D whose _draw draws a plain rect, detached until frame 15). The capture must adopt the pre-arm texture (G8r), the pre-arm process material (PM7) and the two pre-arm items (LATE-RES node_added) at their first post-arm reference, leaving no unknown item RIDs (residue 0) and no refused resource. At free_frame the fixture frees them (the sprite and its texture, the emitter, the ITEM node): the capture must record at least freed_items items, freed_textures texture and freed_particles emitter gone or freed after it.
